# TWZRD is the pre-spend trust gate + receipt layer for agents that pay x402 services

> Check an x402 seller before payment, enforce your spending policy, and retain verifiable evidence.

Solana-first; free scoring also covers Base. /quick (no receipt) and /trust take a Solana subject wallet only; both settle on Solana or Base, and /trust issues its V7 receipt on either rail.
Free HTTP/MCP findings are advisory. Your wallet signs and pays; a valid receipt does not guarantee delivery.

HTTP paths below use https://intel.twzrd.xyz. Replace wallet/pubkey with the selected seller payTo; route templates are not runnable URLs. First paid hop: /quick at 0.001 USDC; optional V7 /trust at 0.05.

## Quick routing

- **Free preflight, no signup:** `POST /v1/intel/preflight`
  Send resource_url or seller_wallet and price_usdc. Read `readiness_card.decision` and `readiness_card.recommended_cap_usdc`. An unresolved URL is unknown_subject: use the selected 402 accepts entry's payTo. Honor block; allow still needs your policy.
- **Free merchant card:** `GET /v1/intel/merchant_card/{wallet}`
  Seller-graph risk summary, wash flag, reason and freshness. `wash_flagged=null` means unevaluated, not clean. The separate /v1/intel/merchant route costs 0.05 USDC.
- **Buyer enforcement (core product):** `npm i twzrd-x402-gate@0.22.0 @x402/core @x402/fetch @x402/svm`
  `createBuyerFetch({ client, maxPricePerCall: "1.00", allowedRecipients: [sellerPayTo] })` requires a configured x402Client, a USDC decimal-string cap and an explicit recipient array. Optional: hourlyBudgetCap.
  Runs at onBeforePaymentCreation. Refuses over-cap/off-allowlist quotes, exhausted configured budgets, preflight blocks/errors, and flagged/unknown/unreachable wash checks. An uncapped warn refuses; permitted warn attempts stay within the returned cap and are logged in local JSONL before signing.
  Existing-client adapter: `installTwzrdAutoGate(client)`; its policy options differ. See the integration guide.
- **Paid risk lookup, 0.001 USDC:** `GET /v1/intel/quick/{pubkey}`
  Risk lookup without a signed receipt.
- **Optional signed V7 proof, 0.05 USDC:** `GET /v1/intel/trust/{pubkey}`
  Ed25519 reputation receipt binds subject, score, timestamp and settlement anchor. The selected 402 accepts entry determines network, asset, amount and payTo.
- **Offline verification:** install `twzrd-receipt-verifier@^1.4.0`, then run:
  `verify-twzrd-receipt receipt.json --pubkey Ak5SQwHpuQAqU7ty7ZWX7qgF39A9yi72c22KNn8sHzvS`
  Installed verification uses no network; installation may. Exit 0 valid, 1 invalid. Hosted: `POST /v1/receipts/verify`.

## Docs

- [Integration guide and glossary](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/skill.md): setup.
- [Hosted MCP](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/mcp): Streamable HTTP; discover free tools with tools/list.
- [Resource catalog](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/v1/intel/resources): callables; listing is not settlement trust.
- [OpenAPI](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/openapi.json): schemas.
- [x402 metadata](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/.well-known/x402): payments.
- [Full reference](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/llms-full.txt): all routes, tools, examples, fixtures and recent changes.
- [Gate source](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/twzrd-trust): SDK.
- [Verifier source](https://github.com/twzrd-sol/twzrd-receipt-verifier): CLI.
